title: Heavenly Creamy French Cream Pudding
description: A floral and creamy French dessert featuring granulated sugar and tempering chocolate, diabetic-friendly and comforting.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together the granulated sugar, unsweetened almond milk, and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the large egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm milk mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the dark chocolate chips until melted and smooth.
Stir in the heavy cream and dried lavender buds.
Strain the mixture into a clean bowl and let it cool to room temperature.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with additional dried lavender buds if desired.
